name: Clear Street
description: Clear Street MCP lets you access your Clear Street account information such as balances, positions, orders, and portfolio history along with real time market data and finance news. Use it to research opportunities, analyze portfolio performance, assess risk scenarios and evaluate sophisticated trading opportunities and hedging strategies.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clear Street to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clear Street to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.clearstreet.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clear Street MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear Street lists 23 MCP tools, including get_account_balances, get_account_positions, get_all_instrument_events, get_clock, get_instrument_analyst_reporting, get_instrument_balance_sheets, get_instrument_by_id, get_instrument_cash_flow_statements, get_instrument_events, get_instrument_fundamentals, get_instrument_income_statements, and get_instruments.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clear Street?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clear Street in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Clear Street MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear Street requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clear Street is developed by Clear Street, LLC.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
